facts.text: In August the Impasse near 5,200 ft can look too sketchy to cross directly; a detour of about 1,000 ft lower, staying east, then regaining height was judged quicker.
From Perfect Pass the final summit ridge in August is a semi-exposed class 2 to 3 walk.
In August the Chilliwack River ford is easy using a log for most of the width, and water is plentiful on Easy Peak up to about 6,000 ft.

notes: Neither harvested track qualifies as a trailhead-to-summit recording of a stored route.
